_comment: The programs that show the dictation button and the programs that use the STT-Suite. The one list the sync script (scripts/sync_badge.py) reads; a program that starts to use the service or to take speech in comes in here, and a copy that is not in it never gets the button. Paths are relative to the folder that holds the repos next to this one.

buttons.name: STT-Suite
buttons.uses: ui/test.js and ui/dictation-mic.js (the page's test dictation) read ui/badge/ itself

buttons.name: Agent-Orc
buttons.uses: frontend/src/components/DictationMic.vue (microphone, GPU mark), DictationPointer.vue (badge at the pointer)

buttons.name: Mundwerk
buttons.uses: ui/badge.html and ui/badge.js (the badge that follows the pointer); the tray icon (src-tauri/src/tray.rs) and the program icon are the files below

buttons.name: AI-ATC
buttons.speech: its own Whisper (backend/stt/whisper.py), not the STT-Suite; the GPU mark only where it knows its Whisper is on the GPU

service_without_button.name: GPU-Orc
service_without_button.how: asks the service to free the cards (/gpu/release)

service_without_button.name: TTS-Suite
service_without_button.how: the other half of the pair; only the service and the GPU release
